info.title: Hanzo Cloud API
info.description: Generated from the live router — every operation below is a route the unified cloud binary actually serves. Tagged by product: the first path segment after /v1/.

get.summary:
config answers the KMS console's runtime settings — the OIDC issuer it signs
in against and the API base it calls.
get.description:
config answers the KMS console's runtime settings — the OIDC issuer it signs
in against and the API base it calls. It carries no secret and needs no
bearer, and it lives under /v1/kms rather than /v1/admin so a gateway that
admin-gates the admin prefix cannot block the console's own config fetch.

get.summary:
listSecrets lists the caller org's secrets at one path and environment, as
metadata only — name, path, environment, scheme.
get.description:
listSecrets lists the caller org's secrets at one path and environment, as
metadata only — name, path, environment, scheme. No value and no ciphertext
is returned, so it is the safe way to see what exists.

parameters.name: env
parameters.description: Env selects the environment to list. Empty means the default environment.

parameters.name: environment
parameters.description: Environment is the operator's spelling of env, honoured when env is absent.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path narrows to a subpath under the org. Empty lists the org root.

parameters.name: secretPath
parameters.description: SecretPath is the operator's spelling of path, honoured when path is absent.

post.summary:
putSecret seals a value and stores it at (path, name, env) under the caller's
own org.
post.description:
putSecret seals a value and stores it at (path, name, env) under the caller's
own org. The value is sealed under a fresh per-secret key, master-key-wrapped,
before it is written — plaintext never touches disk. An existing secret at the
same coordinate is overwritten.

env is REQUIRED and is never defaulted on a write: it is part of the storage
key, so a silent default would commit the value to a bucket the readers that
resolve project/env/path never look in.

env.description: Env is the environment it belongs to.

name.description: Name is the secret's name within its path.

path.description: Path is the org-qualified path it lives at, e.g. "/orgs/hanzo/ci".

scheme.description:
Scheme is how the value is sealed. Every secret written here goes through
kmsstore.Seal, which is ModeStandard — "aead+mlkem": AES-256-GCM under an
ML-KEM-wrapped DEK. The store's other two modes, "tfhe" and "ckks", are
reported verbatim if a row carries one.

names.description: Names is the same set as bare names, the shape the KMS operator reads.

secrets.description: Secrets is the full descriptor of each secret found.

total.description: Total is how many were found.

env.description:
Env is the environment the value belongs to — a first-class part of the
storage key, never defaulted on a write. Required.

name.description: Name is the secret's name within its path. Required.

path.description:
Path is an optional subpath under the org, e.g. "ci". Empty stores at the
org root.

value.description:
Value is the plaintext to seal. Required; it is sealed under a fresh
per-secret key before it reaches disk.

env.description: Env is the environment it was written to.

name.description: Name is the secret that was written.

stored.description: Stored is true when the value was sealed and committed.

apiBase.description: APIBase is the path prefix every secrets call is made under.

brand.description: Brand is the white-label the deployment serves as.

issuer.description: Issuer is the OIDC issuer the console authenticates against.

loginPath.description: LoginPath is where a machine credential is exchanged for a bearer.
